title: George Hunt Williamson as Adamski's handler and Silver Shirts editor

tellings.quote: Now, let's look at uh George Hunt Williamson. So, George Hunt Williamson was um uh it was a pseudonym.

plain: George Hunt Williamson, a figure around George Adamski, a man who claimed to meet beings from space in the 1950s, is said to have been a pseudonym for someone who acted as Adamski's handler and had earlier edited material for the Silver Shirts, a 1930s American political movement led by William Dudley Pelley. The philosopher Jason Jorjani lays this out on Michels' show in 2025 as his own research, citing publications named Valor and Closer Encounters. If true, it would mean early contact stories were shaped by people with political ties and hidden identities.
